entities.name: UniProt:Q8CK28
observations: Exact full-length sequence match (100% identity and coverage) to reviewed Streptomyces coelicolor ATP phosphoribosyltransferase HisG.
Catalyzes ATP + PRPP to form N'-(5'-phosphoribosyl)-ATP; annotated EC 2.4.2.17 with Mg2+ cofactor.
Annotated cytoplasmic; participates in the first step of L-histidine biosynthesis.

entities.name: L-histidine biosynthesis
observations: HisG catalyzes the first step, producing N'-(5'-phosphoribosyl)-ATP from ATP and PRPP.
